title: Which Taylor Swift Era Matches Your Personality?
description: 发现你与霉霉的哪个时代最匹配！回答问题，找到你的音乐人格。

options.text: Dancing to 1989 with glitter and neon lights
Singing acoustic songs in an intimate venue
Joining a massive crowd at the Eras Tour
Watching from a VIP box with perfect view

questions.text: When someone wrongs you, you usually...

options.text: Write a scathing breakup song about them
Write a subtle revenge song (like All Too Well)
Plot your revenge like 'Look What You Made Me Do'

questions.text: Your love language in relationships is...

options.text: Grand romantic gestures (like in Love Story)
Quiet, deep connection (like in Cornelia Street)
Surprise them with gifts (like in Bejeweled)
Blast All Too Well (10 minute version)
Delete all photos and move on (like Clean)
Listen to sad songs on repeat for days

questions.text: Your friends would describe you as...

options.text: The life of the party - always dramatic and fun
The wise one - always giving advice
The loyal one - always there when needed
The mysterious one - hard to read
Upbeat and make you want to dance

questions.text: When making important life decisions, you...

options.text: Going to a party or club
Writing about it in a journal
To be respected as an expert

questions.text: When someone asks about your ex, you...

options.text: Have a whole playlist about them
Give a vague answer and move on

results.title: 1989 Era (ENFP)
results.description: 你是 the 1989 era - fun, outgoing, and always the life of the party! 你 love big gestures and aren't afraid to be the center of attention.

results.title: Folklore/Evermore Era (INFP)
results.description: 你是 the Folklore/Evermore era - deep, introspective, and beautifully complex. 你 找到 magic in the quiet moments.

results.title: Fearless Era (ENFJ)
results.description: 你是 the Fearless era - brave, optimistic, and inspires everyone around you. 你 go after what you want without hesitation.

results.title: Evermore Era (INFJ)
results.description: 你是 the Evermore era - wise, mysterious, and deeply intuitive. 你 see things others miss.

results.title: Midnights Era (ENTP)
results.description: 你是 the Midnights era - complex, sometimes contradictory, but always fascinating. 你 embrace all sides of 你的self.

results.title: Red (Taylor's Version) (INTP)
results.description: 你是 the Red era - emotionally rich, deeply felt, and brilliantly chaotic. 你 feel everything intensely.

results.title: Reputation Era (ESFP)
results.description: 你是 the Reputation era - bold, unapologetic, and fierce. 你 don't care what others think.

results.title: Speak Now Era (ISFP)
results.description: 你是 the Speak Now era - creative, passionate, and speak 你的 truth. 你 write 你的 own story.

results.title: The Tortured Poets Department (ESTJ)
results.description: 你是 the TTPD era - intellectual, complex, and deeply analytical. 你 overthink everything but that's 你的 superpower.

results.title: Debut Era (ISTJ)
results.description: 你是 the Debut era - authentic, country roots, and true to 你的self. 你 started from humble beginnings and stayed genuine.

results.title: Lover Era (ESFJ)
results.description: 你是 the Lover era - romantic, colorful, and all about love in all forms. 你 wear 你的 heart on 你的 sleeve.

results.title: Red (Acoustic) (ISFJ)
results.description: 你是 the acoustic side of Red - quietly powerful, deeply emotional, and always there for 你的 people.

results.title: Miss Eras Era (ESTP)
results.description: 你是 the Miss Eras era - determined, competitive, and always 工作ing toward 你的 next goal. 你 never stop.

results.title: Midnights (3am Edition) (ISTP)
results.description: 你是 the 3am edition of Midnights - private, mysterious, but surprisingly deep when someone gets to know you.

results.title: Eras Tour Energy (ENTJ)
results.description: 你是 the Eras Tour - a master of reinvention, ambitious, and always evolving. 你've got a plan for everything.

results.title: Vault Tracks (INTJ)
results.description: 你是 the Vault tracks - the hidden gems that not everyone 找到s, but those who do are rewarded with brilliance.
